contract: Use the existing validated CI graph, exact planned inventory and canonical partition_required_gates dependency/assignment validation. Add no parallel graph or receipt family.

For each applicable pull-request gate_shard owner, validate the configured shard count and every actual serial shard population using the existing gate_sequence_deadline_ms policy owner. Validate all siblings even when one shard is selected for execution.

Reject missing, duplicate, contradictory or split executor ownership that the current unfiltered shard runner cannot execute without duplication. Empty plans require an actually empty nodes/edges population.
Run admission after planning and before session/proof allocation in preflight and local prospective proof; recheck before native shard provider-proof preparation or gate execution.

Preserve genuinely legacy/direct graph-absent behavior without claiming an outer graph budget. Modern policy with missing graph blocks; authenticated existing legacy allowances remain with their current owner.
Unknown historical timing never replaces declared execution bounds; observed floors and full setup/API/retry/cleanup lifecycle composition remain separate open requirements.

An insufficient current canonical deadline remains an explicit deterministic block until the canonical policy and reconciliation owner repair it. Do not hand-edit generated workflows or authority pins.
verification: Largest individual gate fits while the actual assigned serial sum does not: reject before any dependent allocation, API read or process execution.
Exact derived boundary passes; parallel shard budgets are not summed together; empty and legacy behavior retain explicit scope.
Wrong count, rewritten dependencies, missing/duplicate owners and split job populations block before work.
Both preflight/prospective allocation and native consuming boundaries have executable cause-specific controls; removing the guard must expose the failure.
Canonical private mirrors, architecture, affected behavior, governed checks and installed runtime parity must qualify before integration.

The committed pre-change architecture test already loses lazy import edges by using unresolved discovery facts. Qualify that test through the same exact declared import-root resolver as the authored semantic consumer, retaining all effect ports and explicit exact phase-import edge assertions. Do not delete unreachable ports to make it pass.
